mapper.select: SELECT i.item_class AS itemClass, i.item_name AS itemName, i.amount AS amount, i.expected_amount AS expectedAmount FROM ytsim_header h JOIN ytsim_item i ON i.yrt_id = h.yrt_id WHERE h.emp_id = #{empId} AND h.base_year = #{baseYear} AND h.confirm_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY i.item_class, i.item_name

SELECT i.item_class AS itemClass, i.item_name AS itemName, i.amount AS amount, i.expected_amount AS expectedAmount FROM ytsim_header h JOIN ytsim_item i ON i.yrt_id = h.yrt_id WHERE h.emp_id = #{empId} AND h.base_year = #{baseYear} AND ( (#{yrtId} IS NULL AND h.confirm_yn='N') OR (#{yrtId} IS NOT NULL AND h.yrt_id = #{yrtId}) ) ORDER BY i.item_class, i.item_name
SELECT add_national_tax AS addNational, add_local_tax AS addLocal FROM yrt_result_total WHERE yrt_id = #{yrtId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_ytsim_header.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO ytsim_header(yrt_id, emp_id, base_year, run_label, confirm_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{yrtId}, #{empId}, #{baseYear}, NVL(#{runLabel}, 'AUTO'), 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO ytsim_item(sim_id, yrt_id, item_class, item_name, amount, expected_amount) VALUES (seq_ytsim_item.NEXTVAL, #{yrtId}, #{cls}, #{name}, #{amt}, #{exp})

MERGE INTO yrt_result_total t USING (SELECT #{yrtId} AS yrt_id, #{nat} AS nat, #{loc} AS loc FROM dual) s ON (t.yrt_id = s.yrt_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.add_national_tax = s.nat, t.add_local_tax = s.loc WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(yrt_id, add_national_tax, add_local_tax) VALUES (s.yrt_id, s.nat, s.loc)
